_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Aldwell Library#001.dst: そのメダリオンを見せてください。
Aldwell Library#001.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#002.src: No medallion! What are you then, a changeling?
Aldwell Library#002.dst: メダリオンがない！　じゃあ、君は一体何なんだ？　チェンジリングか？
Aldwell Library#002.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#003.src: Can't say I've ever heard of a '{u}' before.
Aldwell Library#003.dst: 「{u}」なんて、今まで聞いたことがないな。
Aldwell Library#003.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#004.src: Come back when you've got some proof of who you are, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.dst: 自分の正体を証明できるものができたら、また戻ってきてね、「{u}」。
Aldwell Library#004.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#006.src: I thought I told you, you can't fool me!
Aldwell Library#006.dst: 言ったはずだけど、私は騙されないよ！
Aldwell Library#006.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#007.src: Oh, you just want to know what's behind this door?
Aldwell Library#007.dst: ああ、このドアの向こうに何があるか知りたいだけ？
Aldwell Library#007.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#008.src: Fine. No harm in that, I suppose.
Aldwell Library#008.dst: いいわ。別に害はないわね。
Aldwell Library#008.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#009.src: I'm in charge of guarding the new {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#009.dst: 私は新しい{p}図書館の警備を担当しているの！
Aldwell Library#009.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#010.src: It's a collection of every ancient text found around Mistwood that's been put to paper.
Aldwell Library#010.dst: ここは、 Mistwood 周辺で見つかったあらゆる古代の文書を紙に書き写したコレクションなんだ。
Aldwell Library#010.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#011.dst: 本当に「古代」のものばかりだよ。
Aldwell Library#011.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#012.src: You won't get past me, {u}. I know what you really are!
Aldwell Library#012.dst: ここは通さないぞ、{u}。お前の正体は分かってるんだ！
Aldwell Library#012.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#013.src: If you really want me to believe your story, I suppose there's something you could do for me...
Aldwell Library#013.dst: もし本当に私にその話を信じてもらいたいなら、君にやってもらえることがあるはずだ……
Aldwell Library#013.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#014.src: Would you like to hear it?
Aldwell Library#014.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#016.dst: いずれまた戻ってくるだろう。
Aldwell Library#016.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#017.dst: それじゃあ、そうしよう。
Aldwell Library#017.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#018.src: Around {p}, there are four trees that have served as essential parts of our area's history.
Aldwell Library#018.dst: {p}周辺には、この地域の歴史において重要な役割を果たしてきた4本の木があります。
Aldwell Library#018.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#019.src: Flowers grow at their bases too, and they're used in everything from decorating our homes to making helpful remedies.
Aldwell Library#019.dst: 木の根元にも花が咲き、それらは家の飾り付けから、役に立つ薬の材料に至るまで、さまざまな用途に使われています。
Aldwell Library#019.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#020.src: My personal supply is running low right now, so I'm in need of a new bouquet...
Aldwell Library#020.dst: 今、手持ちのストックが少なくなってきたので、新しい花束が欲しいんです……
Aldwell Library#020.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#021.src: My task for you is to go and bring me one of each flower!
Aldwell Library#021.dst: 君にやってもらいたいのは、それぞれの花を一輪ずつ持ってくることだよ！
Aldwell Library#021.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#022.src: The first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#022.dst: 最初の花は、ここから{c2}真東{/}にある「利他主義の白い木」の下に見つかります。
Aldwell Library#022.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#023.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which is growing all around us!
Aldwell Library#023.dst: {c2}私たちの周囲{/}の至る所で育っている「コミュニティの木」の中で、2つ目の花が咲いています！
Aldwell Library#023.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#024.src: The third flower grows by the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#024.dst: 3つ目の花は、{c2}この図書館の南側{/}に横たわる「再生の木」の残骸のそばに咲いている。
Aldwell Library#024.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#025.src: The final flower can be found at the base of the tree of resistance, which the Canopy call their home.
Aldwell Library#025.dst: 最後の花は、{c2}樹冠が住処{/}としている「抵抗の木」の根元に見つけることができます。
Aldwell Library#025.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#026.src: Come back to me with all four of them, and perhaps we could work something out from there.
Aldwell Library#026.dst: 4つ全て持ってきたら、そこから何とか解決策を模索できるかもしれない。
Aldwell Library#026.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#027.src: Have you got me what I asked for yet?
Aldwell Library#027.dst: 頼んだものはもう用意してくれた？
Aldwell Library#027.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#028.src: No? Well, come back when you do.
Aldwell Library#028.dst: 違う？　まあ、手に入れたらまた来てね。
Aldwell Library#028.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#029.src: If you need a reminder, the first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#029.dst: 念のためにお伝えしておくと、最初の花は、ここから{c2}真東{/}にある「利他主義の白い木」の下にあります。
Aldwell Library#029.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#030.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which grows all around us!
Aldwell Library#030.dst: {c2}私たちの周囲{/}の至る所で育っている「コミュニティの木」の中で、2つ目の花が咲いています！
Aldwell Library#030.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#031.src: The third flower grows in the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#031.dst: 3つ目の花は、{c2}この図書館の南側{/}に横たわる「再生の木」の残骸のそばに咲いている。
Aldwell Library#031.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#033.src: I hope that you find them all for the next time we speak.
Aldwell Library#033.dst: 次回お話しする時には、それらをすべて見つけておいていただければと思います。
Aldwell Library#033.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#035.src: I'm sure I'll find a use for them soon.
Aldwell Library#035.dst: きっとすぐに使い道が見つかると思います。
Aldwell Library#035.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#036.src: In the meantime, enjoy access to the {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#036.dst: それまでの間、{p}図書館をぜひご利用ください！
Aldwell Library#036.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#038.src: I don't care what you are any more, just go through to the library...
Aldwell Library#038.dst: もう君が何者かなんてどうでもいいから、さっさと図書館へ行ってくれ……
Aldwell Library#038.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#039.dst: この本のタイトルは{c2}『The Clancyclopedia』{/}。

Aldwell Library#040.src: It seems to be a book about the different clans in the region, though a little dated- it says it was written in {~} NA. Still, could be fun to flick through.
Aldwell Library#040.dst: この地域にあるさまざまな氏族について書かれた本のようですが、少し古いようだ――{~} NAに書かれたとある。それでも、パラパラとめくってみるのも楽しいかもしれない。

Aldwell Library#041.src: ...That's the end of that passage. Read another?
Aldwell Library#041.dst: …この一節はここまでだ。別の箇所を読む？

Aldwell Library#042.src: The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.
Aldwell Library#042.dst: {c1}樹冠は、森で最も古い氏族に数えられ、長年にわたり対立関係にあった3つの独立した氏族――フクロウ族、キツネ族、シカ族――が合併したものである。{/}
Aldwell Library#042.note: {c1}The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.{/}

Aldwell Library#043.src: Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.
Aldwell Library#043.dst: {c1}Cutoff 以前、フクロウ族は{p}全域を統治していた 君主 Caetal が率いていたが、キツネ族やシカ族もその座を争っていた。{/}
Aldwell Library#043.note: {c1}Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.{/}

Aldwell Library#044.src: Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.
Aldwell Library#044.dst: {c1}3つの氏族には、それぞれ独自の強みがあった。キツネ族は戦闘に長けていた。シカ族は戦略の天才だった。そしてフクロウ族は、隠密行動に長けていた。{/}
Aldwell Library#044.note: {c1}Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.{/}

Aldwell Library#045.src: ...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.
Aldwell Library#045.dst: {c1}…それにもかかわらず、 Caetal は民に寄り添う人物だった。その声の祝福のおかげで、彼は地域社会を一つにまとめることができた。三つの氏族は親密な関係を築き、かつては激しい対立関係にあったものが、友好的な関係へと変わった。{/}
Aldwell Library#045.note: {c1}...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.{/}

Aldwell Library#047.src: After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.
Aldwell Library#047.dst: {c1}最初のチェンジリングが発見されその後処刑されたことを受け、 Caetal は職を解かれ、{p}は外界から隔絶された。その後、 Caetal は姿を消した。{/}
Aldwell Library#047.note: {c1}After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.{/}

Aldwell Library#048.src: The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.
Aldwell Library#048.dst: {c1}3つの氏族は、自分たちをこれほどまでに結束させてくれた人物を失ったことに深く打ちひしがれ、一つの集団、樹冠へと統合した。{/}
Aldwell Library#048.note: {c1}The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.{/}

Aldwell Library#049.src: The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.
Aldwell Library#049.dst: {c1}それ以来、樹冠は女王の積極的な敵として活動しており、彼らの仮面はチェンジリングの脅威に対する抵抗の象徴となっている。{/}
Aldwell Library#049.note: {c1}The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.{/}

Aldwell Library#050.src: The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.
Aldwell Library#050.dst: {c1}Kalkalrah 氏族は、{p}の辺境に暮らす氏族であり、雇われの傭兵たちで構成されている。彼らは、金を払ってくれる者なら誰にでも手を貸すため、いかなる同盟関係も結んでいない。{/}
Aldwell Library#050.note: {c1}The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.{/}

Aldwell Library#051.src: When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.
Aldwell Library#051.dst: {c1}しかし、報酬が支払われれば、その価値は十二分に発揮され、この地域でも屈指の腕前を持つ戦士たちである。一般的に、彼らは衛兵の補助役として雇われることが多い。{/}
Aldwell Library#051.note: {c1}When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.{/}

Aldwell Library#052.src: The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.
Aldwell Library#052.dst: {c1}彼らが唯一例外としているのは、女王の軍隊の標的になりたくないため、反王家活動への協力を拒否しているという点である。{/}
Aldwell Library#052.note: {c1}The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.{/}

Aldwell Library#053.src: The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.
Aldwell Library#053.dst: {c1}Peacekeeper 氏族は、{p}に直接居住する集団であり、この町をあらゆる氏族が集う中立で安全な拠点として、また市民が静かに暮らせる場所として維持したいと願う者たちで構成されている。{/}
Aldwell Library#053.note: {c1}The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.{/}

Aldwell Library#054.src: Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.
Aldwell Library#054.dst: {c1}メンバーは通常、氏族の全体的な目標に賛同し、協力したいと考えている地元のボランティア。組織は民主的な構造をとっており、指導者は氏族自身によって選出される。{/}
Aldwell Library#054.note: {c1}Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.{/}

Aldwell Library#055.src: The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.
Aldwell Library#055.dst: {c1}Peacekeeper は、森の中の他のどの氏族からも敵と見なされたくないため、他の氏族に対して中立の姿勢を貫いている。この姿勢により、彼らは事実上すべての者から高い評価を得ている。{/}
Aldwell Library#055.note: {c1}The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.{/}

Aldwell Library#056.src: The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.
Aldwell Library#056.dst: {c1}Lostheth 氏族は、{p}の郊外に暮らす獣使いの氏族である。{/}
Aldwell Library#056.note: {c1}The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#057.src: Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.
Aldwell Library#057.dst: {c1}つい最近まで、 Lostheth 氏族はごく無名の集団であり、関心の低さから解散寸前の状態にあった。{/}
Aldwell Library#057.note: {c1}Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.{/}

Aldwell Library#058.src: However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.
Aldwell Library#058.dst: {c1}しかし、{p}周辺に Adasaur が現れたことで、状況は一変した。獣使いの達人である Lostheth 氏族は、すぐにそれらの生物を支配下に置くことに成功した。{/}
Aldwell Library#058.note: {c1}However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.{/}

Aldwell Library#059.src: In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.
Aldwell Library#059.dst: {c1}そうして、彼らは背中に乗るという慣習を初めて取り入れた。このことはすぐに他の氏族や多くの市民の関心を集め、 Lostheth 氏族は無名の氏族から、森で最も有名な氏族の一つへと躍り出た。{/}
Aldwell Library#059.note: {c1}In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.{/}

Aldwell Library#060.src: This book is called "The Four Virtuous Trees"
Aldwell Library#060.dst: この本のタイトルは{c2}『The Four Virtuous Trees』{/}。

Aldwell Library#061.src: It's some kind of guide both to survival and morals. Give it a read?
Aldwell Library#061.dst: 生き抜くための指針であり、道徳の指針でもあるようだ。読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#062.src: This book is called "The World Outside The Woods".
Aldwell Library#062.dst: この本のタイトルは{c2}『The World Outside The Woods』{/}。

Aldwell Library#063.src: It seems to be a book from {~} KA, talking about other regions. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#063.dst: {~} KAの著書で、他の地域について書かれたもののようだ。読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#064.src: ...That's the end of the introduction. Read another part of the book?
Aldwell Library#064.dst: …これで序文は終わりだ。この本の別の部分を読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#065.src: There are also various illustrations and maps of the {p}, but it looks almost identical to the {p} of today. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#065.dst: また、{p}に関するさまざまな図版や地図も掲載されているが、その姿は今日の{p}とほとんど変わらないようだ。この本をもっと読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#066.src: Next to this description, there is a collection of illustrations of the region. It's completely unrecognizable to you. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#066.dst: この説明文の隣には、この地域のイラスト集が掲載されている。自分にはまったく見覚えのない風景ばかりだろう。この本をもっと読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#067.src: Accompanying the text are sketches of these "great mines," but, as stated by the text, it looked pretty much the same as the regions around it. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#067.dst: 本文には、これらの「大鉱山」のスケッチが添えられているが、本文にもある通り、その様子は周辺地域とほとんど変わらなかった。この本をもっと読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#068.src: There are drawings of the {p} alongside the text. It looks pretty much the same as you saw it on the way to the tournament, though there may be slight differences. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#068.dst: 本文の横には{p}のイラストが載っている。トーナメントに向かう途中で見たものとほぼ同じだが、多少の違いがあるかもしれない。この本をもっと読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#069.src: With the text, there are pictures of Aelumia. Though you didn't get to see too much of the city during the tournament, it looks somewhat different to what you remember. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#069.dst: 本文には、 Aelumia の写真が掲載されている。トーナメント中は街の様子をあまり見ることができなかったが、記憶にある姿とは少し違うようだ。この本をもっと読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#070.src: It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.
Aldwell Library#070.dst: {c1}この森を離れる自由を奪われてから{~}年が経ったが、すでに、私たちの最も若い者たちの多くは、その先にある土地がどのようなものなのかと気にかけている。{/}
Aldwell Library#070.note: {c1}It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.{/}

Aldwell Library#071.src: We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.
Aldwell Library#071.dst: {c1}私たち年長者たちは、この件に関して頼りになる情報源となってきたが、世の中は変わりつつある。私たちも次第にこの世を去りつつある。そこで、私が知っていることを書き残し、将来の世代がそこから学べるように引き継いでいくことにした。{/}
Aldwell Library#071.note: {c1}We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.{/}

Aldwell Library#072.src: In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.
Aldwell Library#072.dst: {c1}北西には{p}が広がっており、そこは広大な森林地帯で、その木々の葉は、{p}内にある数少ない落葉樹の緑色の葉よりも温かみのある色合いを帯びている。{/}
Aldwell Library#072.note: {c1}In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#073.src: A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.
Aldwell Library#073.dst: {c1}この地域には川が流れているが、その水は東にある巨大なダムによってせき止められている。{/}
Aldwell Library#073.note: {c1}A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.{/}

Aldwell Library#074.src: Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.
Aldwell Library#074.dst: {c1}伝説によると、かつてこの森の木々の葉は、私たちのものと同じように緑色だったそうだが、水の流れが弱まったことで葉は色を失い枯れてしまい、その結果、赤みを帯びた色合いになったという。{/}
Aldwell Library#074.note: {c1}Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.{/}

Aldwell Library#075.src: There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.
Aldwell Library#075.dst: {c1}また、「呪われた時代」以前、私たちの知るどの木よりも大きな木があったという伝説もある。今も残るその切り株が、存在を示す唯一の証拠である。{/}
Aldwell Library#075.note: {c1}There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.{/}

Aldwell Library#076.src: The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.
Aldwell Library#076.dst: {c1}{p}には、こうした伝統が数多く受け継がれている。この地域の住民は、どの地域よりも信仰心が厚いからだ。この地域の北端には、古代の神殿の遺跡があり、神を畏れる人々にとって非常に貴重な存在となっている。{/}
Aldwell Library#076.note: {c1}The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.{/}

Aldwell Library#077.src: This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.
Aldwell Library#077.dst: {c1}この神殿もまた、「呪われた時代」以前に建てられたものとされているが、その目的は不明であるため、市民たちはこの神殿にさまざまな伝承を結びつけている。王家は、こうした伝承の多くを異端であると断じているが、それにもかかわらず、それらは根強く残っている。{/}
Aldwell Library#077.note: {c1}This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.{/}

Aldwell Library#078.src: The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.
Aldwell Library#078.dst: {c1}{p}で最大の町は{p}であり、農業地区との境界に位置し、同地区から取引される商品のほとんどがここに集まってくる。町の広場には大きなキツネの像が立っており、この地域を象徴するランドマークとなっている。{/}
Aldwell Library#078.note: {c1}The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.{/}

Aldwell Library#079.src: Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.
Aldwell Library#079.dst: {c1}{p}のすぐ西側、境界線沿いの最も高い木々からまだ見渡せる場所に、農業地区がある。{/}
Aldwell Library#079.note: {c1}Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.{/}

Aldwell Library#080.src: This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."
Aldwell Library#080.dst: {c1}この名称は、地方の他の地域のために農業に専念する地域であることを示すため、王家によって付けられたものだが、地域内の一部の人々は、より気取らない古い呼び名である「Tolas」と呼んでいる。{/}
Aldwell Library#080.note: {c1}This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."{/}

Aldwell Library#081.src: As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.
Aldwell Library#081.dst: {c1}前述の通り、この地域は指定農地帯となっており、すべての市民が他の地域向けの食料を生産するために働いている。{/}
Aldwell Library#081.note: {c1}As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.{/}

Aldwell Library#082.src: Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.
Aldwell Library#082.dst: {c1}Fruma の他の地域から切り離されて以来、私たちはこの労働の成果を受け取れなくなってしまった。とはいえ、時折、反政府派の氏族が、この地域を通過する数多くの王家の物資輸送隊から、そうした産物を盗み出すことに成功することもある。{/}
Aldwell Library#082.note: {c1}Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.{/}

Aldwell Library#083.src: Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.
Aldwell Library#083.dst: {c1}Tolas の数多くの農場は、美しく、広々とした平原に広がっており、そこではシカなどの野生動物が人間と比較的調和して暮らしている。{/}
Aldwell Library#083.note: {c1}Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.{/}

Aldwell Library#084.src: Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.
Aldwell Library#084.dst: {c1}そこの人々は、君主 Amastli の伝統主義的な政策に対する不満を次第に露わにしているものの、概して幸せな生活を送っている。{/}
Aldwell Library#084.note: {c1}Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.{/}

Aldwell Library#085.src: To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.
Aldwell Library#085.dst: {c1}南には 大鉱山が広がっている。その名が示す通り、この地域は古くから資源の採掘が行われてきた。また、農業地区と同様、多くの労働者が暮らしている。{/}
Aldwell Library#085.note: {c1}To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.{/}

Aldwell Library#086.src: The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.
Aldwell Library#086.dst: {c1}大鉱山の実際の地表の地形は、その周辺地域とほとんど見分けがつかない。{/}
Aldwell Library#086.note: {c1}The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.{/}

Aldwell Library#087.src: What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.
Aldwell Library#087.dst: {c1}この地域が他の地域と一線を画しているのは、地中に埋蔵されている貴重な天然資源の多さである。そのため、あちらとこちらとの境界を示す壁が築かれた。{/}
Aldwell Library#087.note: {c1}What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.{/}

Aldwell Library#088.src: Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.
Aldwell Library#088.dst: {c1}この地域の住民のほとんどは、他の地域に見られるような小規模な集落ではなく、鉱業の中心地である Deraj に住んでいる。「呪われた時代」の終焉以来、彼らは果てしなく、情熱を込めて Fruma の採掘を続けてきた。{/}
Aldwell Library#088.note: {c1}Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.{/}

Aldwell Library#089.src: At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.
Aldwell Library#089.dst: {c1}「知識の時代」の幕開け、君主 Oru が即位した頃、辰砂を求めてこれらの採掘活動はさらに活発化した。それ以来、大鉱山の一部はかなり荒廃してしまった。{/}
Aldwell Library#089.note: {c1}At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.{/}

Aldwell Library#090.src: North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.
Aldwell Library#090.dst: {c1}{p}の北には、 Fruma で最も豊かな地域である{p}が広がっている。この地域は丘陵地帯の荒野で、ピンク色の花を咲かせる果実のなる木をはじめ、あらゆる種類の美しい花や植物が生息している。{/}
Aldwell Library#090.note: {c1}North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.{/}

Aldwell Library#091.src: The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.
Aldwell Library#091.dst: {c1}この地域では、影響力のあるさまざまな一族の間で絶え間ないソフトパワーの争いが繰り広げられているが、その中でも「Nasin 家」と呼ばれる一族が、ほぼ一貫して覇権を維持し続けている。その家長である Gitephe は、この地域の君主である。{/}
Aldwell Library#091.note: {c1}The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.{/}

Aldwell Library#092.src: Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.
Aldwell Library#092.dst: {c1}この地域には{p}への玄関口があり、そのため、この地方の貿易の多くはここを通らなければならない。{/}
Aldwell Library#092.note: {c1}Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.{/}

Aldwell Library#093.src: This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.
Aldwell Library#093.dst: {c1}これは王家にとって問題となる。というのも、{p}は{p}へ上る唯一のルートであり、我々の氏族は頻繁に物資輸送隊を襲撃しようとするからだ。{/}
Aldwell Library#093.note: {c1}This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.{/}

Aldwell Library#094.src: Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.
Aldwell Library#094.dst: {c1}{p}のすぐ隣にあるものの、両者は圧倒的な高低差によって隔てられており、そこに{p}が立っている。{/}
Aldwell Library#094.note: {c1}Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.{/}

Aldwell Library#095.src: The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.
Aldwell Library#095.dst: {c1}このダムの建設により、かつては川だった場所が大きな湖となり、その湖のほとりにこの地域の首都である{p}が位置している。{/}
Aldwell Library#095.note: {c1}The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.{/}

Aldwell Library#096.src: This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.
Aldwell Library#096.dst: {c1}この地域には、実に多種多様な魅力的な生き物が生息しているが、民間伝承で広く信じられていることとは異なり、翼のあるヘビは一匹もいない。{/}
Aldwell Library#096.note: {c1}This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.{/}

Aldwell Library#097.src: In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.
Aldwell Library#097.dst: {c1}Fruma のまさに中心には、この地方の首都であり、女王の居城である{p}がある。周囲の地域を見下ろす高原の上に位置しているため、その聳え立つ城壁は、この森に限った光景ではない。{/}
Aldwell Library#097.note: {c1}In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.{/}

Aldwell Library#098.src: Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.
Aldwell Library#098.dst: {c1}都会にいるのは、実に独特な体験だ。森の中で送っている静かな生活とは、まったく異なる。周囲には自然がほとんどなく、建物ばかり。建設に使われていない土地は、一インチたりともない。{/}
Aldwell Library#098.note: {c1}Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.{/}

Aldwell Library#099.src: Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.
Aldwell Library#099.dst: {c1}城塞内には、軍司令部、王立大学、女王の宮殿など、注目すべき場所が数多くある。{/}
Aldwell Library#099.note: {c1}Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.{/}

Aldwell Library#100.src: Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.
Aldwell Library#100.dst: {c1}宮殿の内部を目にする幸運に恵まれたごくわずかな人々は、その光景を、自分たちの想像をはるかに超える、至高の豪華さだと表現した。この森に住む者たちのうち、二度とこのような美しさを目にすることができないのは、実に残念なことだ。{/}
Aldwell Library#100.note: {c1}Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.{/}

Aldwell Library#101.src: According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.
Aldwell Library#101.dst: {c1}先祖代々語り継がれてきた伝説によると、この高原はかつて、視界がほぼ完全に遮られることなく、夜空を眺めるのに世界で最も適した場所だったという。{/}
Aldwell Library#101.note: {c1}According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.{/}

Aldwell Library#102.src: Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.
Aldwell Library#102.dst: {c1}今日では、この有名な城壁がこの眺めの大部分を遮っているため、もはやそうとは言えない。しかし大学には、この城壁の上を越えて星空を眺められる場所があると言われている。{/}
Aldwell Library#102.note: {c1}Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.{/}

Aldwell Library#103.src: ...It seems to be some sort of children's story book. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#103.dst: …どうやら、何かの童話の本のようだ。読んでみる？

Aldwell Library#104.src: This book is called "Sight of Sasha".
Aldwell Library#104.dst: この本のタイトルは{c2}『Sight of Sasha』{/}。

Aldwell Library#105.src: Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.
Aldwell Library#105.dst: {c1}昔々、 Uthak という国に、 Nannah という名の小さな男の子が住んでいた。少なくとも、彼の仲間たちはそう呼んでいた。{/}
Aldwell Library#105.note: {c1}Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.{/}

Aldwell Library#106.src: Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.
Aldwell Library#106.dst: {c1}Nannah は手のかかる、いたずら好きな少年で、いつも年長者の言うことを聞かず、トラブルを免れるために嘘をついていた。{/}
Aldwell Library#106.note: {c1}Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.{/}

Aldwell Library#107.src: One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.
Aldwell Library#107.dst: {c1}ある日、母親は彼を連れて森へ食べ物を探しに出かけた。森は危険な場所だったので、 Nannah は安全のため母親のそばにいる必要があった。しかし、彼はそうしたくなかった。{/}
Aldwell Library#107.note: {c1}One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.{/}

Aldwell Library#108.src: When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.
Aldwell Library#108.dst: {c1}愛する母がベリー摘みに忙しくしている間、 Nannah は自分だけの冒険を求めて森へと駆け出した。とはいえ、それほど遠くまでは行かなかった。なぜなら、出発して間もなく、ある声に呼び止められたからだ。{/}
Aldwell Library#108.note: {c1}When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.{/}

Aldwell Library#109.src: "Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."
Aldwell Library#109.dst: {c1}「Nannah 、やめなさい」と声が言った。「行儀の悪いことをしてはいけないよ。」{/}
Aldwell Library#109.note: {c1}"Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."{/}

Aldwell Library#110.src: Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.
Aldwell Library#110.dst: {c1}Nannah は声のする方、木々の梢の方へと振り返った。そこには、大きくて青い瞳がこちらをじっと見つめていた。その瞳の持ち主は、美しい白い羽を持つフクロウだった。「あなたは誰？」と Nannah は尋ねた。{/}
Aldwell Library#110.note: {c1}Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.{/}

Aldwell Library#111.src: "I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."
Aldwell Library#111.dst: {c1}「私は Sasha だ」とフクロウは言った。「Uthak の裁判官だ。 Nannah 、年長者に従いなさい。彼らが一番よく知っている。」{/}
Aldwell Library#111.note: {c1}"I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."{/}

Aldwell Library#112.src: Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."
Aldwell Library#112.dst: {c1}Nannah はこう答えた。「どうして、 Sasha ？　僕は母さんから遠く離れて旅をしてきたけど、何の問題もないよ。母さんは間違ってたんだ。この森は安全だよ。」{/}
Aldwell Library#112.note: {c1}Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."{/}

Aldwell Library#113.src: "Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."
Aldwell Library#113.dst: {c1}「だって、 Nannah 、私みたいな怪物はお前みたいな悪い子供を食べちゃうんだ。霧をも貫くこの目で、ずっとお前の振る舞いを観察してきたんだ。そんな無礼な振る舞いはやめるんだ。さもないと、私の夕食になっちゃうぞ。」{/}
Aldwell Library#113.note: {c1}"Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."{/}

Aldwell Library#114.src: Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.
Aldwell Library#114.dst: {c1}Nannah はこれに驚いて、母親のいる場所へ駆け戻った。そこには、自分の名前を呼んでいる母親がいた。「Nannah？　Nannah！！！」と彼女は叫んでいた。{/}
Aldwell Library#114.note: {c1}Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.{/}

Aldwell Library#115.src: When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"
Aldwell Library#115.dst: {c1}Nannah が近づくと、母は彼にひどくがっかりしていた。「Nannah 、森の中へ走って行ってはいけないわ」と母は言った。「危険だから！」{/}
Aldwell Library#115.note: {c1}When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"{/}

Aldwell Library#116.src: Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."
Aldwell Library#116.dst: {c1}Nannah は、二度と一人で森には入らないと彼女に約束した。「Nannah 、本当に？」と彼女は言った。「約束は破ってはいけないものよ。」{/}
Aldwell Library#116.note: {c1}Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."{/}

Aldwell Library#117.src: He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.
Aldwell Library#117.dst: {c1}彼はそれに同意し、二人は家路についた。しかし、その夜、 Nannah は眠れなかった。ある考えが頭から離れなかったからだ。{/}
Aldwell Library#117.note: {c1}He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.{/}

Aldwell Library#118.src: "Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"
Aldwell Library#118.dst: {c1}「バカな Sasha め」と彼は思った。「僕に何をしていいか、何をしてはいけないかなんて、誰にも指図されるものか！」{/}
Aldwell Library#118.note: {c1}"Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"{/}

Aldwell Library#119.src: Nannah, not wanting to be bossed around by the owl, made his decision. He got up from his bed, and tip-toed out of his house. He would break his promise he made to his mother, and ignore Sasha's recommendation.
Aldwell Library#119.dst: {c1}Nannah は、フクロウに指図されるのが嫌だったので、決心した。ベッドから起き上がり、つま先立ちで家からこっそりと抜け出した。母との約束を破り、 Sasha の忠告も無視することにしたのだ。{/}
Aldwell Library#119.note: {c1}Nannah, not wanting to be bossed around by the owl, made his decision. He got up from his bed, and tip-toed out of his house. He would break his promise he made to his mother, and ignore Sasha's recommendation.{/}

Aldwell Library#120.src: The forest was dark at night, and barely anything could be seen. The only things Nannah could make out were the Candleferns that dotted the forests.
Aldwell Library#120.dst: {c1}夜になると森は暗くなり、ほとんど何も見えなかった。 Nannah が辛うじて見分けられたのは、森のあちこちに点在する Candlefern だけだった。{/}
Aldwell Library#120.note: {c1}The forest was dark at night, and barely anything could be seen. The only things Nannah could make out were the Candleferns that dotted the forests.{/}

Aldwell Library#121.src: Despite the danger of getting lost, Nannah could not bring himself to admit defeat and head home. He walked from Candlefern to Candlefern, for several minutes, until the quiet sounds of the village were gone. It was silent.
Aldwell Library#121.dst: {c1}道に迷う危険があったにもかかわらず、 Nannah は負けを認めて家に帰る気にはなれなかった。彼は Candlefern から Candlefern へと、数分間歩き続けた。やがて、村の静かな物音が聞こえなくなった。辺りは静まり返っていた。{/}
Aldwell Library#121.note: {c1}Despite the danger of getting lost, Nannah could not bring himself to admit defeat and head home. He walked from Candlefern to Candlefern, for several minutes, until the quiet sounds of the village were gone. It was silent.{/}

Aldwell Library#122.src: "Hello again," said a familiar voice, "I see you have not learned."
Aldwell Library#122.dst: {c1}「また会ったね」と、聞き覚えのある声が言った。「まだ学んでいないようだな」{/}
Aldwell Library#122.note: {c1}"Hello again," said a familiar voice, "I see you have not learned."{/}

Aldwell Library#123.src: "Sasha???" yelped Nannah, "How did you get here? I didn't hear you!"
Aldwell Library#123.dst: {c1}「Sasha ？？？」と Nannah は叫んだ。「どうしてここに？　足音もしなかったよ！」{/}
Aldwell Library#123.note: {c1}"Sasha???" yelped Nannah, "How did you get here? I didn't hear you!"{/}

Aldwell Library#124.src: "I am one with the winds, Nannah, my flight is as silent as the mist itself. Nobody can ever hear my approach. It makes me very good at catching naughty children to have for my dinner."
Aldwell Library#124.dst: {c1}「私は風と一体となっているのだ、 Nannah 。私の飛び方は、霧そのもののように静かだ。誰も私が近づいてくる音を聞くことはできない。そのおかげで、いたずらっ子を捕まえて夕食にするのがとても上手なんだ。」{/}
Aldwell Library#124.note: {c1}"I am one with the winds, Nannah, my flight is as silent as the mist itself. Nobody can ever hear my approach. It makes me very good at catching naughty children to have for my dinner."{/}

Aldwell Library#125.src: Before he knew it, Nannah had been lifted off his feet, and was brought through the darkness to Sasha's wicker nest, never to be seen again.
Aldwell Library#125.dst: {c1}気がつくと、 Nannah は地面から持ち上げられ、暗闇の中を Sasha の籐の巣へと連れて行かれ、二度と姿を見せることはなかった。{/}
Aldwell Library#125.note: {c1}Before he knew it, Nannah had been lifted off his feet, and was brought through the darkness to Sasha's wicker nest, never to be seen again.{/}

Aldwell Library#126.src: The mist of our forest home is dense and widespread; many get lost trying to find their way through the fog. As such, our people have devised various methods to remember the area better.
Aldwell Library#126.dst: {c1}私たちの住む森の霧は濃く、広範囲に広がっています。その霧の中を進もうとして、多くの人が道に迷ってしまいます。そのため、私たちはこの地域をよりよく覚えるために、さまざまな方法を編み出してきました。{/}
Aldwell Library#126.note: {c1}The mist of our forest home is dense and widespread; many get lost trying to find their way through the fog. As such, our people have devised various methods to remember the area better.{/}

Aldwell Library#127.src: One popular method is learning the Virtuous Trees, a group of distinct trees throughout the woods that embody a set of precepts.
Aldwell Library#127.dst: {c1}よく知られている方法の一つに、「美徳の木」を学ぶことがあります。これは、森のあちこちに点在する、それぞれ異なる木々のことで、一連の戒律を体現しています。{/}
Aldwell Library#127.note: {c1}One popular method is learning the Virtuous Trees, a group of distinct trees throughout the woods that embody a set of precepts.{/}

Aldwell Library#128.src: Knowing each of these trees means that they can be used as a reference point if you are lost. They also provide great teachings to live by.
Aldwell Library#128.dst: {c1}これらの木々を一つひとつ知っておけば、道に迷ったときに目印として活用できます。また、それらは人生を送る上での素晴らしい教訓も与えてくれます。{/}
Aldwell Library#128.note: {c1}Knowing each of these trees means that they can be used as a reference point if you are lost. They also provide great teachings to live by.{/}

Aldwell Library#129.src: First is the Tree of Community, the single tree specimen that {p} is built around. Indeed, the trees of {p} are in fact one single specimen, grown from one tree in what is called a "clonal colony."
Aldwell Library#129.dst: {c1}まず「コミュニティの木」です。これは、{p}がその周囲に築かれた、たった1本の木です。実際、{p}の木々は、いわゆる「クローン群体」として1本の木から育った、たった1つの個体に他なりません。{/}
Aldwell Library#129.note: {c1}First is the Tree of Community, the single tree specimen that {p} is built around. Indeed, the trees of {p} are in fact one single specimen, grown from one tree in what is called a "clonal colony."{/}

Aldwell Library#130.src: This tree represents the importance of community and family; that, despite our differences, and our aggressions, we are all one, and must ultimately cooperate to build each other up.
Aldwell Library#130.dst: {c1}この木は、コミュニティと家族の重要性を象徴しています。つまり、私たちには違いや対立があるとはいえ、結局のところ私たちは皆一つであり、互いを高め合うために協力し合わなければならないのです。{/}
Aldwell Library#130.note: {c1}This tree represents the importance of community and family; that, despite our differences, and our aggressions, we are all one, and must ultimately cooperate to build each other up.{/}

Aldwell Library#131.src: Second is the Tree of Altruism, a distinctly different Redwood thanks to its small size and white leaves.
Aldwell Library#131.dst: {c1}2つ目は「利他主義の木」です。これは、その小さなサイズと白い葉のおかげで、他のセコイアとは一線を画す存在です。{/}
Aldwell Library#131.note: {c1}Second is the Tree of Altruism, a distinctly different Redwood thanks to its small size and white leaves.{/}

Aldwell Library#132.src: This tree is in fact an Albino Redwood, and it is believed that its frail appearance is the result of an assistance it provides to its fellow trees.
Aldwell Library#132.dst: {c1}この木は実はアルビノのセコイアであり、そのか弱そうな姿は、周囲の木々を助けていることが原因であると考えられています。{/}
Aldwell Library#132.note: {c1}This tree is in fact an Albino Redwood, and it is believed that its frail appearance is the result of an assistance it provides to its fellow trees.{/}

Aldwell Library#133.src: It is located in the far east side of the {p}, and demonstrates that we should strive to help others, even if at great personal cost.
Aldwell Library#133.dst: {c1}それは{p}の最東端に位置しており、たとえ多大な犠牲を払うことになっても、他者を助けるよう努めるべきであることを示しています。{/}
Aldwell Library#133.note: {c1}It is located in the far east side of the {p}, and demonstrates that we should strive to help others, even if at great personal cost.{/}

Aldwell Library#134.src: Third is the Tree of Renewal, a truly ancient tree that is believed to be one of the first trees in the forest, and among the tallest of all. It is thought to have lived through countless disasters, and healed from each.
Aldwell Library#134.dst: {c1}3番目は「再生の木」です。これは、この森で最初に生えた木の一つであり、最も背の高い木の一つでもあると信じられている、実に古くからの木です。数え切れないほどの災難を乗り越え、そのたびに傷を癒してきたと考えられています。{/}
Aldwell Library#134.note: {c1}Third is the Tree of Renewal, a truly ancient tree that is believed to be one of the first trees in the forest, and among the tallest of all. It is thought to have lived through countless disasters, and healed from each.{/}

Aldwell Library#135.src: The Tree of Renewal shows that we should take time to rest and heal; to prioritize our own wellbeing when it is necessary, rather than solely sticking to altruism alone.
Aldwell Library#135.dst: {c1}「再生の木」は、私たちが休息と癒しの時間をとるべきであることを示しています。つまり、ただ利他主義に固執するのではなく、必要な時には自分の心身の健康を最優先すべきだということです。{/}
Aldwell Library#135.note: {c1}The Tree of Renewal shows that we should take time to rest and heal; to prioritize our own wellbeing when it is necessary, rather than solely sticking to altruism alone.{/}

Aldwell Library#136.src: Fourth and final is the Tree of Resistance, a towering, resilient tree that is home to The Canopy Clan.
Aldwell Library#136.dst: {c1}4つ目にして最後が「抵抗の木」です。これは、 樹冠の住処となっている、そびえ立つ強靭な木です。{/}
Aldwell Library#136.note: {c1}Fourth and final is the Tree of Resistance, a towering, resilient tree that is home to The Canopy Clan.{/}

Aldwell Library#137.src: Though outwardly unremarkable, its location is important to consider. It stands in deforested land, yet lives on, thriving despite the destruction of its habitat. It symbolizes our collective resistance to oppressors.
Aldwell Library#137.dst: {c1}一見すると何の変哲もないが、その立地は重要な意味を持つ。それは森林が伐採された土地に立ちながらも生き続け、生息地が破壊されてもなお繁栄している。それは、抑圧者に対する私たちの集団的な抵抗を象徴している。{/}
Aldwell Library#137.note: {c1}Though outwardly unremarkable, its location is important to consider. It stands in deforested land, yet lives on, thriving despite the destruction of its habitat. It symbolizes our collective resistance to oppressors.{/}

Aldwell Library#138.src: Remember these trees, and their virtues. It may save your life, and guide you to great friendships.
Aldwell Library#138.dst: {c1}これらの木々と、その美徳を忘れないでください。それがあなたの命を救い、素晴らしい友情へと導いてくれるかもしれません。{/}
Aldwell Library#138.note: {c1}Remember these trees, and their virtues. It may save your life, and guide you to great friendships.{/}
